1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Nxe5 Nxe5.strategy: Drives the f6 knight back with the pawn, gaining space and time. White's central pawns and lead in development are the compensation for the piece; if Black consolidates safely, White is simply a piece down.

Retreats all the way home and keeps the extra piece, but undoes Black's development, so White's pawns dominate the centre. Black has to catch up in development without falling into tactics, and may return the material for a calmer game.
